entry.title: Rates up a fifth week with September quoted 14 to 41% higher, and the first low-water advisory is posted
entry.summary: The Coast Guard posted the season's first low-water advisory on the Lower Mississippi, the export corridor rose $1.19 to $19.28 a ton, and USDA's forward quotes now date the squeeze: September carries the premium, November is quoted back near par.

entry.title: The low-water rate spike came two months early
entry.summary: Barge freight on the lower Mississippi jumped 24 percent in the last full week of July, a move this river usually saves for late September.

entry.title: Rates up $3.55 with October quoted 25 to 44% higher, and Memphis forecast below zero by Aug 7
entry.summary: Every river system rose for the week ending July 28. The Lower Mississippi export corridor jumped $3.55 to $18.09 a ton, and USDA's published forward curve now quotes every origin region above its current rate three months out.
